prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers.

summary:
[reference generation] In the nearly empty office at dusk, <Subject 1> closes his laptop, leans back and releases a small breath, looking out toward the dark windows.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, soft highlight roll-off and restrained contrast, in cool blue-gray evening tones.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up, seated at his desk in the nearly empty open-plan office at dusk and turned three-quarters toward the left, his face sharp and evenly lit. On the light wooden desk in front of him stand an open silver laptop, its screen facing him and away from the camera, and to its right a white ceramic coffee mug with a handle; a closed black notebook lies beside the mug. Behind him, softly out of focus, rows of empty desks and pushed-in chairs sit under dimmed ceiling lights, and the floor-to-ceiling windows show a dark-blue skyline with scattered lit windows. At the start his eyes are on the laptop screen for a moment. He lowers the lid with both hands in one gentle, unhurried movement until it closes with a soft click, and his eyes follow his hands down to the closed laptop. Then he leans back slightly in his chair, lets his shoulders drop, releases a small, quiet breath through his nose, and his gaze drifts to the left toward the dark windows and the city lights, where it rests; he blinks once. His face stays calm and neutral, ordinary end-of-day tiredness without sadness. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical and look at the same target; he never looks into the lens. The camera holds a static shot. His lips stay closed; he does not speak. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet ventilation in the empty office, the soft click of the laptop lid closing, a gentle chair creak as he leans back and his small breath.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
